name: Moles, reacting masses and limiting reactants

terms.definition: The amount of substance containing 6.02 × 10²³ particles (the Avogadro constant).
terms.examiner: Higher tier. One mole of a substance has a mass in grams equal to its Ar or Mr.
Higher tier. Rearrange: mass = moles × Mr.

terms.definition: The reactant that is completely used up and so limits the amount of products.
terms.examiner: Higher tier. The other reactant is in excess.

terms.definition: Convert each mass to moles, divide by the smallest number of moles to get the ratio, and use it to balance the equation.
